title: TAT-3015 — Perps single-position summary RoE matches position card
description: Validates that the Perps home unrealized P&L summary RoE follows the single open position stream and stays aligned with the position card RoE.

ac1-inject-desynced-roe.expression: (async()=>{var sm=stateHooks.getPerpsStreamManager();var positions=sm.positions.getCachedData()||[];var base=positions[0];if(!base){return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'missing position cache',matches:false})}var freshPosition=Object.assign({},base,{unrealizedPnl:'4.20',marginUsed:'10',positionValue:'14.20',returnOnEquity:'0.42'});var account=sm.account.getCachedData()||{};sm.account.pushData(Object.assign({},account,{unrealizedPnl:'1.00',returnOnEquity:'1'}));sm.positions.pushData([freshPosition]);window.__tat3015RoeProbe={staleAccountRoe:'1.00%',positionRoe:'42.00%'};await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);var summary=document.querySelector('[data-testid="perps-balance-dropdown-pnl"]')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()||'';var card=document.querySelector('[data-testid^="position-card-roe-"]')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()||'';var summaryMatch=summary.match(/\(([^)]+%)\)/);var summaryRoe=summaryMatch?summaryMatch[1]:'';var cardRoe=card.replace(/[()]/g,'');return JSON.stringify({ok:true,summaryRoe:summaryRoe,cardRoe:cardRoe,matches:summaryRoe===cardRoe,summary:summary,card:card,positionReturnOnEquity:freshPosition.returnOnEquity,accountReturnOnEquity:'1'})})()

ac1-screenshot-roe-sync.note: AC1: the unrealized P&L summary row RoE matches the individual ETH position card RoE with one open position.

ac2-screenshot-position-source.note: AC2: after a fresh position stream update and stale account RoE cache, the summary row still displays the same RoE as the position card.
